notes: The clarifying question ruled out dodgeball, tag and trick scoring, so there is no round structure and this is not Party & Casual, and with no course to complete it is not an obby either - what is left is a physics playground where the bouncing itself is the entertainment, which is Roblox's Physics Sim subgenre and therefore Simulation. I took the Physics Sim preset but swapped its world-open shape for interior-single, since the author specified an indoor hall that is the whole map, which needs no exterior and no transition and so stays P0 rather than picking up P3. Physics-rig carries the main trampoline floor and the foam pit as the functional apparatus, path-circulation the walkways and run-ups between beds, and I dropped hazard-kill because nothing in a bright commercial park is meant to hurt anyone. Entertainment's Indoor Venue was the close call and I rejected it because its options describe a room to look at rather than equipment to use; the author also asked for no extra attractions, so nothing beyond the floor and the pit was added.
